line_items.work_text: School Safety: (i)Preparation of School & College Disaster Management Plans and Mock Drill (ii) Safety Audit of Schools (iii) Training of Teachers on School Safety

Disaster Preparedness for Hospitals: i)Training of Doctors and hospital administrators on Hospital Preparedness & Mass Causality Management ii) Training of Nurses, Paramedics, Medical Technicians on Mass Casualty Management

Training on Earthquake Resistant Construction Techniques: i) ToT at State HQ and District level training of Engineers/ Architects on Earthquake Resistant Technique ii) Masons training on Safe Construction Practices
Role of PRIs/ ULBs in DM (Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Reduction in development planning): i) ToT at State HQ and ii) 27 district level trainings
Climate Change & Disaster Management: Two-day ToTs at Guwahati, Tezpur, Dibrugarh, Silchar
Community based disaster preparedness: i)Training of VDPs on S&R and First Aid through Civil defence ( 7 districts) ii)Ward level Training on S&R and First Aid

narrative: SEC approved the modified Plan 2012-13 of 13th Finance Commission Grant for Capacity Building.
